scope: Strict immutable metadata, coordinate-only nominal arithmetic, unknown-aware uncertainty and rejection of unresolved predictions at observing boundaries; no arrival-time resolver
input_policy: Numeric source values are finite decimal strings, at most 24 significant digits, with nonzero magnitude at least 1e-24 and at most 1e9. No binary-float coercion. Period in [0.125,365.25] days; normalized epoch in [2400000,2500000] JD; cycles in [-10000,10000].
arithmetic_policy: 80-digit Decimal context; exact bounded coefficient addition/multiplication before sqrt. Midpoint and symmetric contacts remain in declared source coordinate. Supported arithmetic: barycentric TDB with coordinate-duration basis, or observer TAI with observer-elapsed basis.
uncertainty_policy: Known symmetric standard deviations and finite PSD covariance only; unknown contributing terms stay null with reason; cycle zero uses epoch uncertainty alone; zero covariance requires supplied evidence or an explicit recorded assumption. Independent analytic standard-deviation test bound 1e-70 days, fixed before tests.
eligibility_policy: All coordinate predictions remain unresolved. BJD/HJD and unknown coordinates cannot become observing instants through scale relabelling; even observer TAI needs a separately validated adapter before downstream enablement.
compatibility_policy: Existing numeric scalar APIs remain legacy arithmetic. Strict objects cannot silently enter existing numeric observing paths. Legacy UI requires an explicit acknowledgement and exports carry an unvalidated timing label.
evidence_policy: Regression and analytic contract checks only. The 26 Mission 36 scenarios retain their original prospective record; Mission 37 reports a separate coverage matrix. Existing numerical reference fixtures and canonical records stay unchanged.
